business_summary: Guangdong Redwall New Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of concrete admixtures and fine chemicals in China and internationally. It offers polycarboxylic acid and naphthalene water reducers; polycarboxylic acid and polynaphthalene slump retainers and plasticizers; early strength, air entraining, quick setting, waterproofing, and de-grinding agents; retarders; and sodium gluconate and other admixtures. The company also provides fine chemical products such as polyether monomers, nonionic surfactants, hydroxyl esters, and polyether polyols. Its products are used in commercial concrete, precast concrete components, premixed mortar, and other building materials. Guangdong Redwall New Materials Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Huizhou, China.
